description_en: Lists the details of one or more views
kebab_example: aliyun dlfnext list-view-details --catalog-id clg-paimon-xxx --database database_name --max-results 1000 --page-token example-string --view-name-pattern view% --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListViewDetails

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data catalog
parameters.name: catalog_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results. If the response does not include this token, pass an empty string ("")
parameters.help_zh: 翻页令牌，用于获取下一页数据。如果响应结果中没有提供，则传空字符串（""）或空字符（''）
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.help_en: A pattern to filter view names
parameters.name: view_name_pattern
